training: Same initial random vector and mutation draws; 32 greedy bounded uniform mutations per initializer. Every candidate evaluated through three self-generated descendants on fixed training-support/query populations. task_only minimizes parent query loss averaged across three query sets; self_target minimizes mean descendant query loss. Both pay full identical compute; chosen initial artifact is candidate parent.
budget: 33 candidates per initializer, each charged three full self-target proposal/evaluation unrolls plus parent query evaluation. Fresh evaluation arms each receive eight scalar meta-objective probes per generation, unconditional child adoption.
evaluation: Clean-process proposals and scoring; no holdout score affects training or descendants; fixed external scalar oracle and interpreter.
limits: An external evolutionary search trains initial parameters. The experiment tests useful heredity, not independence from external optimization or AGI. No retuning or stopping based on results.
